userStories.title: Field-digest dispatch + bounded replanning
userStories.description: Replace the 8K-char upstream-output stuffing with the PRD-166 field digest under a per-task budget (Q22); bounded replanning (LLMCompiler-style joiner) + progress ledger/stall counter (Magentic-One pattern) on mission execution with audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Dispatch prompt size drops ≥60% on the multi-task fixture; golden task still passes DONE — _prepare_task's 8K-per-upstream stuffing DELETED (with dispatcher's 'Previous Task Outputs' render + matcher's stuffing probe, grep-gated); upstream outputs now flow as {key,value} rows (_collect_upstream_digest_rows, sanitized+capped like field injection) merged AHEAD of field hits (field_scoring.merge_dispatch_rows dedupes the field's echo) through the ONE _attach_field_digest choke point under Config.FIELD_QUERY_TOKEN_BUDGET; tests/test_prd164_dispatch_digest.py proves >=60% drop on the 3x8K fixture (smoke-measured 24,213→4,381 chars = 82%) with the GOLDEN-FACT surviving into the prompt + platform_field_query pointer for what the budget drops; degraded mode (no Qdrant) still carries upstream rows; synthesis path deliberately keeps full upstream (its min_length criterion is 50% of combined upstream)

Induced stall triggers replan-or-halt within bounds + audit (test) DONE — Magentic-One progress ledger (modules/coordination/progress_ledger.py, pure: progress/churn/idle + stall streak, history bounded at 20) + LLMCompiler-style joiner (_joiner_checkpoint after reconcile in _process_run, RUNNING runs only); churn x COORDINATOR_STALL_LEDGER_LIMIT → REPLAN through the EXISTING replan_mission (parametrized actor_type/trigger='stall_ledger': may take a RUNNING looping run, skips mid-flight loop states, points planner at the max-attempt churner) bounded by COORDINATOR_MAX_REPLANS, then HALT (FAILED, StopReason.STALLED, mission memory recorded); tests/test_prd164_progress_ledger.py: induced retry-loop replans exactly once with trigger, exhausted-replans halts, 40-tick churn stays bounded at 2 replans + 1 halt, audit = run_stall_ledger events + run.config['progress_ledger'] history incl. replan_reset rebaseline; replan hard-failure falls back to halt
